newsitem.title: UK: One 2 One has 545,000 customers at end 1996.
newsitem.headline: One 2 One has 545,000 customers at end 1996.

text.p: UK mobile telephone company One 2 One said on Monday it had a total of 545,000 customers as at December 31, 1996.
The company, a joint venture between Cable & Wireless Plc and a unit of US West Media Group, said it added 85,000 subscribers net in the final quarter of 1996.
A company spokeswoman said that One 2 One had 375,000 customers at the end of 1995. Its share of the UK cellular market had risen to eight percent by the end of 1996.

One 2 One said it achieved its best ever level of monthly gross connections during December while the final three months of 1996 represented its highest ever quarterly net growth. In the corresponding 1995 quarter it added only 35,000 subscribers.

"Since the launch of our new marketing initiatives and brand campaign in October, coupled with a fast-expanding service area, we have seen strong growth in sales of the One 2 One service," said Managing Director Jan Peters.
"Our network rollout programme continues apace, and during the course of the next few months we shall be opening up distribution of the service in many more areas of the country," Peters added.
One 2 One said it had achieved a consistent month-on-month decrease in the level of disconnections in the last quarter of the year.
One 2 One has expanded its service area in the last quarter to reach the cities of Cardiff in South Wales, Norwich in eastern England and the northern English regions of West Yorkshire and Tyneside.
It expects its service to be available to 95 percent of Britain's population by December of this year.
